# Mutation bias investigation

## 0. General

### 0.1. load libraries

```{r}
library(lme4)
```

## 1. estimating experiment wide Ti/Tv ratio

```{r}
syn_titv <- read.csv("../results/TiTV_count_per_pop_non-overlapping_ORFS.csv")

```

```{r}
fit <- glmer(cbind(Ti, Tv) ~ 1 + (1 | population), data = syn_titv, family = binomial)
summary(fit)

```

estimate 95% CI

```{r}
mu <- fixef(fit)[["(Intercept)"]]
ci <- confint(fit, parm = "(Intercept)", method = "profile")
exp(c(Ti_Tv = mu, lower = ci[1], upper = ci[2]))
```

```{r}
confint(fit, parm = "theta_", method = "profile")
```

compare to null
